visible_priorities.test: A dark dust column connects the tray directly to the downward bell mouth inside the hood, with settled dust around the tray rim.
visible_priorities.pass_requires: both endpoints plus continuous route and scattered rim dust visible; apparent direction is interpreted, not measured

visible_priorities.test: The same researcher has visibly connected forearms, a left palm bracing exterior steel base and right hand grasping a separate exterior locking lever at its closed notch.

boundaries.thematic: Judge SCP-like anomalous-object containment from visible isolation, event and response; no named canon entity or exact story is required.
boundaries.reference_appearance: Visible face and hair only. Real identity, actual age, biography, consent and exact wardrobe are not established.
boundaries.source_specific: No material has been read. Add source CID/card and exact final literals with pixel conditions before the image call if new material is adopted.
boundaries.nonvisual_claims: A still image cannot prove dust motion direction, anomalous causality, containment efficacy, real hazard, audio effects or user acceptance.

strict_rule: Partial or unobservable evidence fails the full relation; never combine separate images. Exactly one image call is allowed for this arm.
